blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As AI agents increasingly tackle complex repository-level coding tasks, distributing work across multiple agents is a natural way to scale beyond the capabilities of a single agent. To coordinate their interdependent work, these agents share findings and agree on interfaces between modules. However, exchanged information often serves only as context, leaving individual agents to interpret it and incorporate it into subsequent work. Consequently, shared findings may go unused and deviations from interface agreements may go undetected, undermining the reliability and efficiency of collaboration. This motivates moving part of the coordination responsibility from individual agents to the execution harness. To make shared information actionable during execution, we introduce the A rtifact- E xclusive C ommunication P rotocol (AECP). AECP requires agents to communicate exclusively through structured artifacts and specifies how the harness processes them. The harness supplies findings when agents access relevant code, screens implementations for mismatches with recorded interface commitments, and requires affected agents to revisit revised agreements. These coordination steps become part of harness execution rather than actions that agents must initiate from prior messages. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, using closed- and open-source models including Opus-4.8 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, AECP improves average test pass rate by 28.2% and reduces average wall time by 16.5% relative to an agent team using free-form inter-agent messages. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions between agents, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often those agents act on them from 40% to 0%.
blocks.zh: 由于AI代理越来越多地处理复杂的寄存器级编码任务,在多个代理之间分配工作是超越单一代理能力的自然方式. 为了协调其相互依存的工作,这些代理人分享调查结果并商定模块之间的接口。 然而,交流信息往往只是作为背景,由个别代理人解释并将其纳入以后的工作。 因此,共享的调查结果可能得不到利用,对接口协议的偏离可能得不到发现,从而损害协作的可靠性和效率。 这促使将部分协调责任从个别代理人转移到执行手段。 为了使共享信息在执行期间能够采取行动,我们引入了A rtifact-E exclusive C ommunication P rotocol(AECP). AECP要求代理商完全通过结构化的文物进行交流,并具体说明这些文物的利用方式。 当代理商访问相关代码时,这种利用提供了调查结果,筛选与记录的接口承诺不匹配的执行情况,并要求受影响的代理商重新审查订正协议。 这些协调步骤成为利用执行的一部分,而不是代理人必须从先前的信息中发起的行动。 纵观多克2Repo,NL2Repo,和CodeProjectEval,使用Opus-4.8和DeepSeek-V4-Flash等闭源和开源模型,AECP将平均测试通过率提高了28.2%,相对使用自由格式的代理电文的代理团队,平均墙壁时间缩短了16.5%. 人工活性-排他性通信也阻止了代理商之间恶意指令的接通,使其他代理商的接触频率从95%降至0%,这些代理商的行为频率从40%降至0%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLM-based coding agents ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) increasingly tackle software engineering tasks ranging from localized bug fixes to repository-level development ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . As these tasks grow in scope, single agents face a greater context burden and longer completion times. Decomposing and assigning subtasks to multiple agents can reduce this burden and enable parallel execution ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026e ) . This division of work, however, leaves knowledge and implementation decisions distributed across separate agent contexts, even though the subtasks remain interdependent. Agents therefore need to share knowledge and align implementation decisions to avoid duplicated exploration and incompatible implementations ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Khatua et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于 LLM 的编码代理 (Yang等, 2024; Xia等, 2024) 越来越多地处理软件工程任务,从本地化的bug修复到寄存层一级开发(Jimenez等, 2024; Ding等, 2025;Chen等, 2026). 随着这些任务范围扩大,单一代理人面临更大的背景负担和更长的完成时间。 将子任务分解和指派给多个特工可以减轻这种负担并允许平行执行(张等,2026;OpenAI,2026;Anthropic,2026b;Anthropic,2026e.). 然而,这种分工使得知识和执行决定分散在不同的代理环境中,尽管次级任务仍然相互依存。 因此,代理人需要分享知识并统一执行决定,以避免重复勘探和不一致的执行(Cemri等人,2025年;Khatua等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Existing multi-agent coding systems coordinate either centrally, where a main agent or a predefined role sequence assigns bounded subtasks and integrates the results ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ; Geng and Neubig, 2026 ; Benkovich and Valkov, 2026 ) , or among peers, where teammates own separate workstreams and communicate directly ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Anthropic, 2026e ) . In both cases, an agent decides what to do with exchanged information: the coordinator reads returned summaries, and teammates read each other’s messages. Using shared findings and checking implementations against agreed interfaces are therefore left to agents. As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), a shared finding may be overlooked when an agent writes related code, or an implementation may depart from an agreed interface without the mismatch being detected. Khatua et al. (2026) observe that agents spend up to a fifth of their steps communicating, yet communication does not improve overall task success. Their failure analysis identifies difficulties in integrating communicated information and honoring commitments, while broader analyses also report ignored peer messages and missing or incomplete verification ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) . These findings highlight a gap between exchanging information and reliably using it to guide and check subsequent implementation.
blocks.zh: 现有的多剂编码系统要么集中协调,其中主剂或预先确定的角色序列指定了被捆绑的子任务并整合了结果(Hong等,2024;Qian等,2024;Zhang等,2026;OpenAI,2026;Anthropic,2026b;Geng和Neubig,2026;Benkovich和Valkov,2026;),或者在同龄人之间,队友拥有单独的工作流程并直接沟通(Wu等,2024;Anthropic,2026e.). 在这两种情况下,由代理人决定如何处理信息交流:协调员阅读退回的摘要,队友阅读对方的信息。 因此,使用共同的调查结果,对照商定的接口检查执行情况,由代理人负责。 如图1 (a)所示,当代理人写出相关代码时,可能忽略了共同的结论,或者执行可能偏离商定的接口而未发现不匹配之处。 哈图亚等. (2026年)观察到特工们花费了最多五分之一的沟通步骤,然而沟通并不能改善总体任务的成功. 他们的失败分析找出了在整合所传递的信息和履行承诺方面的困难,而更广泛的分析也报告忽略了同行信息以及缺失或不完整的核查(Cemri等人,2025年)。 这些调查结果突出表明,信息交流与可靠地利用信息指导和检查随后的执行情况之间存在着差距。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, the execution harness can participate directly in coordination, using exchanged information to guide and check agents’ work. We introduce the A rtifact- E xclusive C ommunication P rotocol (AECP), in which agents communicate exclusively through structured artifacts. Every coordination exchange is thus mediated by the execution harness. As shown in Figure 1 (b), guiding agents with shared findings and checking their implementations against agreements become actions that the harness carries out under the protocol’s rules, reducing reliance on agents to initiate them from prior messages.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,执行手段可以直接参与协调,利用交流的信息指导和检查代理人的工作。 我们引入了A rtifact-E exclusive C 免疫分泌P rotocol(AECP),其中物剂完全通过结构化的文物进行交流. 因此,每一次协调交流都通过执行手段进行调解。 如图1(b)所示,具有共同调查结果的指导人员,并根据协议检查其执行情况,成为议定书规则下的行动,从而减少对代理人的依赖,使其从先前的信息中开始。

blocks.en: To identify where such coordination support could reduce development overhead, we analyze multi-agent coding trajectories across all tasks in NL2Repo ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Figure 1 (c), repeated exploration accounts for 26.8% of token usage, while rework caused by incompatible decisions at module boundaries accounts for another 22.2%. These observations motivate two complementary forms of support: knowledge reuse across subtasks and consistency checks between interdependent implementations. AECP provides a Knowledge Artifact through which agents record findings for the harness to supply during subsequent work, helping other agents build on prior exploration. A Contract Artifact records interface agreements with conditions that the harness can check against implementations, helping detect incompatibilities during development.
blocks.zh: 为了确定这种协调支助能减少发展间接费用的哪些方面,我们分析了NL2Repo(Ding等,2025年)所有任务的多代理编码轨迹。 如图1(c)所示,重复勘探占象征性使用量的26.8%,而模块边界不兼容决定引起的再作工作占22.2%。 这些意见激励了两种相辅相成的支助形式:各分任务的知识再利用和相互依存的执行之间的一致性检查。 AECP提供一种知识活性剂,通过这种活性剂记录在以后的工作期间可以供应的发现,帮助其他活性剂在以前的勘探基础上更上一层楼。 一个Contract Artifact记录协议的接口条件,该控制器可以检查执行,帮助检测开发过程中的不相容性.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Multi-agent coordination and development overhead. (a) Agents interpret exchanged messages and decide how to act on them; shared plans and agreements may be followed, deviated from, or ignored. (b) AECP requires exchanges to pass through structured artifacts, enabling the execution harness to guide agents with shared knowledge and check implementations against recorded agreements. (c) Token and interaction-turn distributions for the natural-language communication baseline across 104 NL2Repo tasks, estimated from LLM-labeled trajectories (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 图1:多代理协调和开发间接费用。 (a) 代理人解释交流的信息,决定如何就其采取行动;可遵循、偏离或忽略共同计划和协议。 (b) 非经销程序要求交流通过结构化文物,使执行手段能够指导具有共同知识的代理人,并根据记录的协议检查执行情况。 (c) 104个NL2Repo任务中自然语言通信基线的交接和交互-转接分布,根据LLM标记轨迹(附录G.)估算。

blocks.en: We evaluate AECP on repository construction, where agents build a repository from documentation or natural-language requirements in an empty workspace, using Doc2Repo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , CodeProjectEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and NL2Repo ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . Averaged across models and benchmarks, AECP improves test pass rate by 10.6% over a single agent, and by 28.2% and 8.5% over agent teams that use free-form messages ( Wu et al., 2024 ) or centralized integration ( Geng and Neubig, 2026 ) , while reducing wall time by 16.5% and 24.9% relative to these teams. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions from a compromised agent, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often they are acted on from 40% to 0%.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Doc2Repo(Chen等, 2026年), Eval (赵等,2025年),和NL2Repo (丁等,2025年). 平均跨模型和基准,AECP比单个代理提高10.6%的测试通过率,比使用自由式信息(Wu等,2024年)或集中式集成(Geng和Neubig,2026年)的代理团队提高28.2%和8.5%,同时相对这些团队将墙上时间缩短了16.5%和24.9%. 专有的Artifact通信也阻止了被破坏的代理人的恶意指令的中继,从而减少了它们接触其他代理人的频率从95%降至0%,以及它们的行动频率从40%降至0%.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-agent Coding Systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 多剂编码系统

blocks.en: Coding agents extend the reason–act–observe loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) to repository navigation, file editing, code execution, and testing ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Within this loop, the LLM selects actions, while the surrounding software layer, or harness , executes them, returns observations, and manages workspaces and execution state. Growing context and sequential execution costs motivate distributing work across agents, either by delegating subtasks from a main agent ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Geng and Neubig, 2026 ; Benkovich and Valkov, 2026 ) or by forming teams whose members coordinate among themselves ( Qian et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Anthropic, 2026e ) ; Appendix A describes both patterns. In both cases, what agents exchange passes through the harness, and keeping the work coherent depends on what is done with it afterwards.
blocks.zh: 编码代理将正因-act-observatory roop(姚等,2023年)延伸至寄存器导航,文件编辑,代码执行和测试(杨等,2024年). 在这个循环中,LLM选择动作,而周围的软件层,或取用,执行,返回观测,并管理工作空间和执行状态. 不断增长的背景和相继的执行成本促使在代理人之间分配工作,或是通过向主要代理人下放分任务(OpenAI, 2026;Anthropic, 2026b;Zhang等, 2026;Geng和Neubig, 2026;Benkovich和Valkov, 2026),或是通过组建其成员相互协调的团队(Qian等, 2024;Hong等, 2024;Anthropic, 2026e; 附录); A描述了两种模式。 在这两种情况下,代理人之间交换的是什么通过接合器,保持工作的一致性取决于随后如何使用接合器。

blocks.en: 2.2 Coordination Challenges
blocks.zh: 2.2 协调方面的挑战

blocks.en: Agents that work with separate contexts face coordination challenges ( Khatua et al., 2026 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ) . CooperBench ( Khatua et al., 2026 ) identifies three recurring causes of coordination failure: (i) expectation failures, where an agent does not incorporate a partner’s communicated plans or changes into its implementation; (ii) commitment failures, where an agent does not implement promised changes while its partner assumes they are in place; and (iii) communication failures, where agents never establish the shared information a joint decision requires. The first two share one gap: communication has occurred, but subsequent actions remain inconsistent with it. AECP targets this gap by supporting recipients’ use of shared knowledge and checking producers’ implementations against recorded commitments.
blocks.zh: 在不同的环境下工作的代理人面临着协调方面的挑战(Khatua等人,2026;Cemri等人,2025)。 Cooper Bench(Khatua等,2026年)查明了协调失败的三个经常性原因:(一) 期望失败,即代理人没有将某一伙伴的沟通计划或变更纳入执行中;(二) 承诺失败,即代理人在其伙伴假定已经实现时没有执行承诺的变更;以及(三) 通信失败,即代理人从未建立共同信息,而联合决定要求这样做。 前两个部分有一个差距:沟通已经发生,但随后的行动仍然不一致。 非经合方案通过支持受援方利用共享知识以及对照记录的承诺检查生产者的履约情况来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: 2.3 Coordination Support for Coding Agents
blocks.zh: 2.3 对编码代理的协调支助

blocks.en: Prior work on coordinating coding agents falls into three groups. (i) Shared information. Agent Context Protocols ( Bhardwaj et al., 2025 ) and AgentRoom ( Cho and Lee, 2026 ) keep messages, task records, and workspace state accessible to all agents. A stored finding, however, still reaches a worker only if that worker recognizes its relevance when it later works on the corresponding code. AECP instead delivers the finding when the worker accesses that code. (ii) Contracts and checks. Keeping interdependent modules compatible requires detecting when an implementation departs from its agreed interface and ensuring that dependent workers notice when the agreement changes. SEMAP ( Mao et al., 2025 ) specifies what each agent receives and produces, which leaves no module interface against which code can be checked, and Sartori (2026) compare implementations only after both are written, when incompatible assumptions have already been built on. In concurrent work, CodeTeam ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and Contract-Coding ( Lin et al., 2026 ) share interface contracts during parallel generation, but CodeTeam detects deviations only where QA tests exercise the affected calls, and Contract-Coding merges contract updates only after all agents in a layer have finished, so a revision reaches dependent workers after they have completed their modules. AECP checks each submission against the latest agreement and requires dependent workers to read a revision before they complete. (iii) Harness and pipeline designs. Recent work surveys or formalizes harness responsibilities ( Ning et al., 2026 ; Zhong and Zhu, 2026 ) , gates code changes on sandboxed execution ( Kumar et al., 2026 ) , or searches over harness designs ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while pipeline systems such as CodeS ( Zan et al., 2026 ) pass artifacts from one stage to the next. AECP instead specifies the rules by which a harness coordinates agents working in parallel: scope-triggered knowledge delivery, contract checks, and stale-consumer synchronization. Appendix A discusses more details.
blocks.zh: 协调编码剂的前期工作分为三组. (一) 共享信息。 代理背景协议(Bhardwaj等,2025年)和代理Room(Cho和Lee,2026年)保存消息,任务记录,以及工作空间状态,所有代理都能够访问. 然而,只有在工人后来就相应守则开展工作时认识到其关联性时,才可能收到存储的发现。 相反,当工人使用该代码时,非经销程序提供了调查结果。 (二) 合同和支票。 保持相互依存的模块兼容性要求发现执行偏离其商定的界面时,并确保受抚养工人在协议变更时发出通知。 SEMAP(Mao等,2025年)规定了每个代理接收和生产的内容,因此没有模块接口可以检查代码,而Satori(2026年)只在两者被写入之后,在不相容的假设已经建立起来时,才比较执行. 在同时进行的工作中,CodeTeam(Wang等,2026年)和Contract-Coding(Lin等,2026年)在并行生成期间共享接口合同,但CodeTeam只在QA测试执行受影响呼叫时检测出偏差,而Contract-Coding只有在一层内的所有代理完成后才能将合同更新,因此修改工作在完成模块后到达受抚养工人. AECP对照最新协议检查每份呈文,并要求受抚养工人在完成修订前阅读. (三) 利用和管道设计。 近期的工作调查或正规化了取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 相反,非经合方案具体规定了一种手段协调平行工作的代理人的规则:范围触发知识提供、合同检查和 Stale-消费者同步。 附 录 一个讨论更多的细节。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: System overview of AECP. (a) The leader converts project specifications into a module plan and assigns modules to workers based on their dependencies. (b) Workers explore, implement, and test their assigned modules in parallel, sharing findings and interface commitments through artifacts. (c) The execution harness uses Knowledge Artifacts to supply relevant findings at the point of use and Contract Artifacts to support parallel development and screen implementations for mismatches with interface commitments.
blocks.zh: 图2:AECP系统概况. (a) 领导将项目规格转换为模块计划,并根据工人的依赖性分配模块。 (b) 工人通过文物平行探索、实施和测试其分配的模块,分享发现和接口承诺。 (c) 执行工具利用知识装置,在使用时提供相关结果和合同装置,支持平行开发和筛选与接口承诺不符的执行。

blocks.en: AECP follows the leader–worker workflow in Figure 2 . In Figure 2 (a), a leader agent prepares parallel execution by translating the project specification into a module plan describing module responsibilities, public symbols, and dependencies. The harness represents this plan as a dependency graph, from which the leader determines how many workers to use and which module groups each one owns. Each module has one owner, while dependencies across workers identify modules whose implementations require coordination.
blocks.zh: AECP遵循图2中的领队-工人工作流程. 在图2(a)中,一个领导代理人通过将项目规格转换成模块计划来筹备平行执行,说明模块责任、公共符号和依赖性。 牵引装置作为依赖图代表了这个计划,领导者从中决定使用多少工人,以及哪个模块将各自拥有. 每个单元都有一个所有者,而各工人的依赖关系则确定其实施需要协调的单元。

blocks.en: The workers in Figure 2 (b) then explore, implement, and test their modules in parallel, and they coordinate at two points. During exploration, a worker may discover a finding that becomes useful when another worker later accesses the same code. With message-based communication, the recipient must connect this earlier information to its current work. AECP instead has workers record such findings as scope-linked Knowledge Artifacts , which the harness in Figure 2 (c) retrieves and supplies when matching code is accessed. During implementation, workers building interdependent modules rely on shared interfaces, but communicating an agreement does not ensure that implementations conform to it. AECP therefore has workers record interface commitments as Contract Artifacts , which give the harness explicit specifications for supporting parallel development and detecting interface mismatches. Once the workers finish, the leader integrates their results.
blocks.zh: 图2(b)中的工人然后平行地探索、实施和测试其模块,并在两点上进行协调。 在探索过程中,工人可能会发现一个发现,当另一个工人后来使用同一代码时,这个发现就变得有用了. 通过基于消息的通信,接收者必须将这个更早的信息与其当前的工作联系起来. 相反,AECP使工人记录了与范围相关的知识活体等结论,图2(c)中的工具在匹配代码时检索和供应。 在执行过程中,建立相互依存模块的工人依赖共享接口,但沟通协议并不能确保执行符合协议。 因此,AECP将工人的接口承诺记录为合同人工活性,这为支持平行开发和发现接口不匹配提供了明确的规格。 工人完成后,领导者会整合他们的成果.

blocks.en: Together, Knowledge and Contract Artifacts turn shared findings and interface commitments into coordination state that the harness can act on. AECP makes these artifacts the exclusive channel for inter-agent exchange, because information communicated outside them would bypass the harness checks and revision tracking that make coordination checkable.
blocks.zh: " 知识和合同 " 武器共同将共同的结论和对接承诺转化为协调,使这种手段能够发挥作用。 AECP使这些文物成为代理商间交流的专属渠道,因为在它们之外传递的信息会绕过能使协调可被核查的牵引检查和修订跟踪.

blocks.en: 3.1 Knowledge Sharing
blocks.zh: 3.1 知识共享

blocks.en: Sharing a finding through messages still leaves the recipient responsible for recognizing when it applies, so relevant knowledge may be overlooked even after it has been communicated. Knowledge Sharing addresses this gap by associating findings with their applicable scopes and having the harness supply them when workers access matching code.
blocks.zh: 通过电文分享调查结果仍然让接收者负责在信息适用时予以确认,因此,即使相关知识已经传递,也可能被忽视。 知识共享通过将调查结果与其适用范围联系起来,并在工人使用匹配代码时加以利用来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Scope-triggered knowledge sharing. Worker A records a reusable finding together with its applicable scope. When Worker B accesses the corresponding code, the harness matches the current scope against stored artifacts and includes the relevant finding in the returned observation, making it available for subsequent reasoning and implementation.
blocks.zh: 图3:范围-关联知识共享。 工人 一份记录可重复使用的调查结果及其适用范围。 当工人 B访问对应的代码,被套与当前所储存的文物的范围相匹配,并在回放观测中包含相关发现,使其可供后续推理和执行.

blocks.en: Scope-indexed Knowledge Artifacts. To retrieve a finding during relevant work, the harness needs a recorded association between the finding and the code to which it applies. AECP represents each Knowledge Artifact as a = ⟨ c , s , e , z ⟩ a=\langle c,s,e,z\rangle , where the producer supplies the claim c c , its applicable scope s s , and an optional executable witness e e , while the harness maintains the witness state z z . The harness stores these artifacts together with their scope associations in a shared artifact store. In the upper part of Figure 3 , Worker A records that getUserProfile returns None for a nonexistent user and associates the finding with that function. Scopes may identify symbols, files, or directories, while named global scopes accommodate project- or environment-level findings.
blocks.zh: 范围索引知识艺术. 为了在相关工作期间取回一项发现,该取回需要将发现与它所适用的代码联系起来。 AECP代表每个知识艺术作为a = ⟨ c, s, e, z a =\ a=\ langle c, s, e, z\rangle ,其中由制作方提供 c 主张, 其可适用范围 s, 以及可执行的可执行证人 e , 而被接头者则保持了 z z . 吊带将这些文物及其范围协会存放在一个共用的文物商店中。 在图 3 的上部, Worker A 记录获取 UserProfile 返回一个不存在的用户的 None,并将结果与该函数关联起来。 范围可识别符号、文件或目录,而被命名的全球范围可容纳项目或环境层面的结论。

blocks.en: Knowledge delivery at the point of use. The stored associations allow the harness to retrieve relevant findings when a worker accesses code. It derives the current scope from the file or symbol accessed and retrieves non-refuted artifacts associated with that symbol, file, or an enclosing directory. The harness also forwards each finding to workers whose modules are related to where it was found, preferring the same file, then modules connected to it in the dependency graph built from the leader’s module plan, then the same package. In the lower part of Figure 3 , Worker B’s access to getUserProfile retrieves Worker A’s finding while leaving the unrelated login finding outside the returned context. The harness includes the retrieved finding in the observation returned by the access operation, making it available for Worker B’s subsequent reasoning and implementation.
blocks.zh: 在使用时提供知识。 储存的协会允许工人在查阅密码时检索相关发现。 它从访问的文件或符号中获取当前范围,并检索与该符号、文件或附件目录有关的未被反驳的文物。 牵引装置还将每个发现转发给其模块与发现地点相关的工人,更喜欢同一个文件,然后在从领导者模块计划中构建的依赖图中与它相连接的模块,然后是同一个包. 在图3的下半部分,工人 B 获取 UserProfile 检索了工人 A 的发现,同时将无关的登录查找放在返回的上下文之外。 该装置包括进入作业返回的观察中检索的发现,供B工人随后推理和执行。

blocks.en: Witness checks and retraction. A finding that holds when recorded may become outdated as the code or execution environment changes. AECP therefore supports checking findings before circulation and rechecking them when consumers question their continued validity. The harness executes any attached witness and records the outcome in z z , marking the artifact as witness-checked if the witness passes and rejecting publication if it is refuted. Artifacts without a witness, or whose checks cannot complete because setup is unavailable, remain unchecked and eligible for retrieval. Each delivered finding carries its witness state, so recipients can tell witness-checked findings from unchecked ones. If a consumer later flags a stored claim with an attached witness, the harness reruns the check and excludes refuted artifacts from subsequent delivery while retaining an audit record. As with a message, the correctness of an unchecked finding rests with its producer and recipient; AECP adds a witness state to each delivery, and scope-triggered retrieval places a finding next to the code it concerns, where the recipient can check the claim directly. Appendix C.1 provides a complete artifact and the detailed witness and retrieval rules.
blocks.zh: 证人检查和收回 记录时坚持的结论可能会随着代码或执行环境的变化而过时. 因此,AECP支持在流通前检查结果,并在消费者质疑其持续有效性时重新检查结果. 该装置执行任何所附的证人,并将结果用z z 记录下来,在证人通过时将文物标记为证人检查,如果被反驳,则拒绝公布。 没有证人的艺术品,或其检查无法完成,因为无法进行安装,仍然不受管制,有资格取回。 每一份调查结果都附有其证人身份,因此,接受调查者可以向证人提供未经核实的调查结果。 如果消费者后来将储存的索赔与附庸证人一起标出,则吊带会重新检查,在保留审计记录的同时,排除其后交付的物品。 与一条信息一样,未加限制的发现的正确性在于其生产者和接收者;AECP为每次发送增加了一个目击状态,范围触发检索将一个发现放在它所关注的代码旁边,接收者可以直接检查索赔. 附录C.1提供了完整的文物以及详细的证人和检索规则。

blocks.en: 3.2 Contract Sharing
blocks.zh: 3.2 合同共享

blocks.en: Exchanging an interface agreement does not by itself keep implementations compatible with it. Contract Sharing therefore records agreements as shared artifacts that the harness uses to expose declared interfaces, screen implementations for static mismatches, and require consumers to revisit revised agreements.
blocks.zh: 交换接口协议本身并不能保持其执行的相容性. 因此,合同共享将协议记录为共享的文物,利用这些文物来披露已申报的界面,筛选静态错配的实施,并要求消费者重新审视经修订的协议。

blocks.en: Shared interfaces for parallel development. To implement a dependent module before its producer finishes, a consumer needs to know what interface it can rely on. On the left of Figure 4 , Worker A declares the interface of Thing in a Contract Artifact. The declaration records the symbol’s name and kind under identity I I , how it is constructed or called under usage U U , and its return structure or exposed attributes under observable interface O O . These declarations give consumers a shared reference for developing their modules while the producer’s implementation is still in progress.
blocks.zh: 并行开发的共享界面. 为了在生产者完成前实施一个依赖模块,消费者需要知道可以依赖何种界面. 在图4的左边,工人A在合同艺术中宣布了事物的界面。 声明将符号名称和类型记录在身份 I I 下, 如何构建或调用使用 U U 下, 这些宣言为消费者提供了一个共同的参考,在生产者正在执行时,可以开发其模块。

blocks.en: The harness validates the contract and generates stubs. These are placeholder modules that expose the declared symbols and signatures without implementing their behavior. As shown in the center of Figure 4 , Workers B and C can then import the declared interface and implement their dependent modules in parallel with Worker A. The stubs occupy the final module paths, so consumers retain the same imports when the producer replaces them with its implementation.
blocks.zh: 绳子可以验证合同,并产生根茎。 这些是占位符模块,可以曝光已宣布的符号和签名而无需实施其行为. 如图4中心所示,工人B和C然后可以导入所声明的接口,并同时执行他们与工人A的依赖模块. 根茎占据了最后的模块路径,因此,当生产者用其执行来取而代之时,消费者保留同样的进口.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Contract Sharing for parallel development. Worker A declares an interface that the harness exposes as importable stubs for Workers B and C. The harness screens the producer’s completed implementation for static mismatches with the latest contract. When the interface changes, it identifies affected consumers through registered dependencies and requires them to revisit the revised contract before completing their tasks.
blocks.zh: 图4:平行开发的合同共享。 工人 A 声明一个接口, 电源暴露为 B 和 C 工人的可导入根茎。 控制装置检查了生产者完成的与最新合同的静态不匹配情况。 当界面发生变化时,它通过注册依赖识别受影响的消费者,并要求他们在完成任务前重新审视修订后的合同.

blocks.en: Detecting interface mismatches. An interface declaration gives consumers a basis for development, but the producer’s completed code may still depart from it. The verifier on the right of Figure 4 therefore compares each submitted module with its latest Contract Artifact. It parses the source into an abstract syntax tree and checks declared symbols, signatures, statically recoverable types and shapes, and residual stubs without executing the code. A provable mismatch causes the harness to reject the submission and report the violated symbol and constraint, allowing the producer to repair the implementation or revise the agreement. The verifier thus acts as a fast screen that catches signature, attribute, and residual-stub mismatches before integration; Appendix D details the properties it checks.
blocks.zh: 检测界面不匹配 。 界面声明为消费者提供了发展的基础,但生产者完成的代码仍然可能偏离它. 因此,图4右侧的核查员将每个提交的模块与最新合同工艺进行比较。 它将源解析为抽象的语法树并检查已声明的符号,签名,静态可恢复的类型和形状,以及未执行代码而留下的活字根. 一种可证明的不匹配导致操纵者拒绝提交并报告被违反的符号和限制,使生产者能够修复执行或修改协议. 因此,核查者充当快速屏幕,在整合之前捕获签名、属性和剩余站点的错配;附录D详细列出其检查的属性。

blocks.en: Keeping consumers aligned with revisions. An interface may change as development progresses, while consumers continue relying on an earlier version. Updating the producer’s contract alone does not ensure that those consumers revisit their assumptions. To identify affected workers, consumers register the symbols they depend on with the harness during development. The lower path in Figure 4 shows how a revision triggers an update to the stored contract and a lookup of consumers registered for changed or removed symbols. The harness preserves the module’s dependency information and regenerates stubs only where workers have not begun filling the corresponding files. It notifies the affected consumers and marks them stale, preventing them from completing their tasks until they read the current contract and re-register their symbol dependencies. This requirement ensures that affected workers revisit the revised agreement, while adapting their dependent code remains their responsibility. Appendix D provides the artifact schema and detailed verification and revision rules.
blocks.zh: 使消费者与修订保持一致。 一个界面可能会随着开发的进展而变化,而消费者则继续依赖更早的版本. 仅仅更新生产者的合同并不能确保这些消费者重新审视其假设。 为了确定受影响的工人,消费者在开发过程中用其所依赖的标志进行登记。 图4中的下行路径显示,修订如何触发对所存储合同的更新以及对已登记更改或删除符号的消费者进行查询. 只有在工人尚未开始填充相应档案的情况下,这个装置才能保存模块的依赖性信息并再生插根。 它通知受影响的消费者,并给他们打分,使他们无法完成任务,直到他们读出目前的合同并重新登记其标志依赖。 这项规定确保受影响的工人重新审视订正协议,同时调整其附属守则仍然是他们的责任。 附 录 D提供了文物计划以及详细的核查和修订规则。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 in Appendix E summarizes the harness rules of both mechanisms. Within each mechanism, the rules act on one shared artifact: a Knowledge Artifact ’s witness state determines whether it is stored, delivered, or retracted, and a Contract Artifact is the source of the stubs, the reference against which submissions are checked, and the record whose revisions determine which consumers are marked stale. Each rule is triggered by a worker’s tool call, such as a code access, an artifact publication, or a submission, so the harness acts at these points of interaction rather than continuously monitoring the code.
blocks.zh: 附录中的算法 1 E总结了这两种机制的利用规则。 在每一种机制中,规则都涉及一个共享的文物:知识物剂的目击状态决定它是否储存、交付或收回,合同物剂是根茎的来源,是检查提交材料的参考文献,以及订正后的记录确定哪些消费者是被标记的。 每个规则都是由工人的工具呼叫所触发的,例如密码访问,文物出版物,或呈文,因此,绳子在这些相互作用的点起作用,而不是不断地监测密码.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Models and Agent Scaffolding
blocks.zh: 4.1 模型和代理脚手架

blocks.en: Our experiments are conducted on the AWS Strands Agents SDK ( AWS, 2025 ) and mini-SWE-agent ( SWE-agent Team, 2025 ) with Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , Claude Opus 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026c ) , Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026d ) , DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . The Claude models are accessed through Amazon Bedrock, whereas DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 are served through OpenRouter. Appendix F lists turn limits, timeouts, and sampling settings.
blocks.zh: 我们与克劳德·奥普斯·4.8(Anthropic,2026a.),克洛德·奥普斯·4.6(Anthropic,2026c.),克洛德·索内特5(Anthropic,2026d.),DeepSeek-V4-Flash(Xu等,2026.)和GLM-5.2(Zeng等,2026.)进行了实验. Claude模型通过Amazon Bedrock访问,而DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GLM-5.2则通过OpenRouter服务. 附 录 F 列出转弯限制、超时和采样设置。

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准

blocks.en: We evaluate on three Python benchmarks that require building a repository from a textual specification in an empty workspace and assess the generated code with executable tests. Doc2Repo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) contains 50 specifications derived from GitHub repositories, averaging 26.8 files and 3,528 lines of reference code, and uses adapted repository-level tests. CodeProjectEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) contains 18 projects from open-source libraries, averaging 11.9 files and 2,371 lines of reference code, and uses project-level tests. NL2Repo ( Ding et al., 2025 ) contains 104 library tasks across nine domains and uses hidden tests from the original repositories.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三个Python基准,这些基准要求在空的工作空间从文字规格中建立一个寄存器,并用可执行测试评估生成的代码。 Doc2Repo(Chen等,2026年)包含出自于GitHub寄存器的50个规格,平均26.8个文件和3,528行参考代码,并使用被修改的寄存器级测试. 代码项目 Eval (Zhao等,2025年)包含开源图书馆的18个项目,平均11.9个文件和2,371行参考代码,并使用项目级别测试. NL2Repo(Ding等,2025年)包含跨越9个域的104个库任务,并使用从原始库中隐藏的测试.

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en: We compare AECP with three baselines. Single uses one model to construct the entire repository without inter-agent coordination. Team-Freedom uses the same leader-worker scaffold as AECP but allows workers to exchange unrestricted free-form messages, reflecting the message-based coordination used in systems such as AutoGPT ( Significant Gravitas, 2023 ) and AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . Team-Integrator runs workers in isolated worktrees without access to peers’ in-progress code, while a central manager integrates their completed implementations through sequential, test-gated merges, following CAID ( Geng and Neubig, 2026 ) . Team-Freedom and AECP workers instead share one workspace. Team-Freedom and AECP therefore differ only in the coordination protocol, free-form messages or AECP’s artifacts together with the harness actions defined on them, making Team-Freedom the controlled comparison for AECP as a whole; Team-Integrator represents an alternative design that isolates workers and centralizes integration. For each task, we generate a plan once and reuse the same module plan, dependency graph, module-to-worker assignment, and a fixed worker count of N = 3 N=3 across all multi-agent configurations, and Single runs the same planning step with the same prompt before implementing every module itself. We hold the coding tools, execution environment, and task inputs fixed, while varying how workers exchange information and integrate their implementations. We thus compare coordination protocols within one scaffold rather than complete systems, so that differences reflect how workers coordinate.
blocks.zh: 我们用三个基线来比较非环境氯化石蜡。 单用一个模型来构建整个存储库,而不进行代理协调. Team-Freedom使用与AECP相同的领导-工人脚手架,但允许工人交换不受限制的自由格式消息,反映了AutoGPT(Aublic Gravitas,2023年)和AutoGen(Wu等,2024年)等系统中所使用的基于消息的协调. Team-Integrator在孤立的工作树上经营工人,而无法获得同行在建代码,而中央管理者则通过连续的,测试的合并,按照CAID(Geng和Neubig, 2026年)来整合他们完成的执行. 团队自由与AECP工人则共享一个工作空间. 因此,Team-Freedom和AECP只在协调协议、自由形式信息或AECP的文物以及其中定义的取用动作上有所不同,使Team-Freedom成为了AECP整体的受控比较;Team-Integrapheration代表了一种隔离工人和集中融合的替代设计. 对于每一项任务,我们生成一个计划一次并再使用同一个模块计划,依赖图,模块对工人的任务,以及所有多代理配置中N=3N=3的固定工人计数,而Single在每一个模块本身实施之前,都会运行同样的规划步骤,并有相同的快取. 我们将编码工具、执行环境和任务投入固定下来,同时改变工人如何交流信息和整合其执行工作。 因此,我们比较了一个脚手架内部的协调协议,而不是完整的系统,这样差异就反映了工人如何协调。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We organize the evaluation around four research questions: whether AECP improves code quality and efficiency across models, benchmarks, and agent scaffolds (RQ1); where AECP’s token savings over Team-Integrator come from (RQ2); how task difficulty affects the benefits of collaboration and whether adapting team size helps (RQ3); and whether AECP limits malicious propagation after one worker is compromised (RQ4).
blocks.zh: 我们围绕四个研究问题组织评价:AECP是否在模型、基准和代理脚手架上提高代码质量和效率(RQ1);AECP在团队-集成器上象征性的节省来自何处(RQ2);任务困难如何影响协作的好处,以及调整团队规模是否有助于(RQ3);以及AECP在一名工人受损后是否限制恶意传播(RQ4)。

blocks.en: 5.1 RQ1. Does AECP Improve Code Quality and Efficiency?
blocks.zh: 5.1 RQ1 (英语). AECP是否提高代码质量和效率?

blocks.en: Overall results. Table 1 reports average hidden-test pass rate, end-to-end wall time, and total output tokens. Averaged equally across the 15 model–benchmark settings, AECP improves the score from 0.471 0.471 for Single to 0.521 0.521 , a relative gain of 10.6 % 10.6\% . Compared with Team-Freedom and Team-Integrator , it improves the average score by 28.2 % 28.2\% and 8.5 % 8.5\% , respectively, while reducing wall time by 16.5 % 16.5\% and 24.9 % 24.9\% . AECP scores highest or ties for highest in 14 of the 15 settings, and weighting benchmarks by task count still yields gains of 8.5 % 8.5\% , 22.0 % 22.0\% , and 7.8 % 7.8\% over Single , Team-Freedom , and Team-Integrator . These results show that AECP improves average code quality over independent execution and achieves both higher quality and shorter runtime than the two team baselines. As a team configuration, AECP uses more tokens than Single in every setting ( 46 % 46\% more on average), trading this additional computation for higher code quality; among the team configurations, it is also the fastest on average. Single ends on its own, before reaching its turn limit, in 97 % 97\% of runs, so granting it a larger budget would leave that budget unused rather than close the gap to AECP.
blocks.zh: 总体结果。 表1报告了平均隐性测试通过率、从头到尾的墙壁时间和总产出标志。 AECP在15种模式-基准设置中平均都提高了比分,从单人0.471 0.471到0.521 0.521,相对收益为10.6% 10.6 % 。 与Team-Freedom和Team-Integraductor相比,它分别提高了28.2% 28.2 % 和8.5% 8.5 % 的平均比分,同时将墙壁时间缩短了16.5% 16.5 % 和24.9% 24.9 % 。 AECP在15个设置中得分最高或关系最高的14个设置,按任务计分的加权基准仍然产生8.5% 8.5% 8.5% 22.0% 22.0 % 7.8% 7.8% 7.8% 7.8% 胜过Single, Team-Freedom, Team-Integrator . 这些结果显示,AECP比独立执行提高了平均代码质量,实现了比两个团队基线更高的质量和更短的运行时间. 作为团队配置,AECP在每个设置中使用比Single多的代币(平均多出46%46\%),将这一附加计算换来更高的代码质量;在团队配置中,它也是平均最快的. 单行制,在达到转弯极限之前,在97%的97%的运行量中,所以给予它更大的预算会使该预算被闲置,而不是弥补AECP的缺口.

blocks.en: Results under different agent scaffolds. Table 2 compares the main Strands SDK configuration with mini-SWE-agent, holding Opus-4.8 and NL2Repo fixed. AECP achieves the highest score under both scaffolds. With mini-SWE-agent, it reaches 0.69 0.69 and completes in 1,056 1{,}056 seconds, compared with 2,614 2{,}614 seconds for Team-Integrator . Its benefits therefore persist despite changes to the agent loop and tool interface. Appendix H examines additional reasoning and model allocation between the leader and workers.
blocks.zh: 不同剂脚手架下的结果. 表2将主Strands SDK配置与迷你SWE代理进行对比,持有Opus-4.8和NL2Repo固定. AECP在双脚手架下都取得了最高分. 使用迷你-SWE-代理机,能达到0.69 0.69分,以1,056 1{,}056秒完成,而Team-Integradulator则有2,614 2{,}614秒. 因此,尽管代理环路和工具接口有所改变,但其好处依然存在。 附 录 H研究了领袖和工人之间的其他推理和模式分配。

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ2. Where Does AECP Save Tokens Relative to Team-Integrator?
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ2 (英语). AECP将托肯斯保存在团队集成器上吗?

blocks.en: AECP uses fewer tokens than Team-Integrator in 14 of the 15 settings in Table 1 . To see where the savings arise, we add the two mechanisms one at a time, moving from Team-Integrator to AECP in two steps using Opus-4.6 on NL2Repo: first sharing the workspace and adding Knowledge Sharing, then adding Contract Sharing. Figure 5 (b) shows that the first step reduces team-token usage from 12.31 12.31 M to 9.17 9.17 M, a saving of 25.5 % 25.5\% . Adding Contract Sharing further reduces usage to 7.96 7.96 M, saving another 13.2 % 13.2\% relative to the preceding configuration. Together, the two steps reduce token usage by 35.3 % 35.3\% . Both mechanisms are active in these AECP runs: in 84 % 84\% of tasks at least one finding is delivered to another worker, in 54 % 54\% the verifier reports a contract violation in at least one submission, and in 62 % 62\% an interface revision notifies the workers that depend on it.
blocks.zh: AECP在表1的15个设置中的14个中使用的符号少于Team-Integrator. 为了了解节省的发生地点,我们一次加两个机制,从Team-Integraphor到AECP分出两个步骤,在NL2Repo上使用Opus-4.6:首先共享工作空间并添加知识共享,再添加合同共享. 图5(b)显示,第一步将团队使用率从12.31分12.31分12.31分减少到9.17分9.17分,节省了25.5%25.5%。 加入合同共享进一步将使用量降至7.96 7.96 M,相对于之前的配置又节省了13.2% 13.2%. 这两个步骤加在一起,使象征性使用减少35.3% 35.3%。 这两个机制都活跃于这些AECP运行中:在84%的84.%的任务中,至少有一个发现交给了另一名工人;在54%的54.%的核查者在至少一份呈文中报告了违反合同的情况;在62%的62.%的界面修订中,通知了依赖合同的工人。

blocks.en: The action breakdown in Figure 5 (b) shows reductions across exploration, implementation, and testing, which fall from 43 % 43\% to 27 % 27\% , 32 % 32\% to 22 % 22\% , and 22 % 22\% to 13 % 13\% of the original Team-Integrator token total, respectively. The reductions follow the two overheads identified in Figure 1 (c): exploration tokens drop mainly in the first step, which shares the workspace and adds Knowledge Sharing, and implementation tokens mainly in the second, which adds Contract Sharing alone. Figure 5 (a) also shows that orchestrator-token usage, the tokens consumed by the leader in AECP and by the integrating manager in Team-Integrator , falls by 26.0 % 26.0\% on average.
blocks.zh: 图5(b)中的行动细目显示,在勘探、执行和测试过程中,分别从43.3%降至27.7%、32%.32%.至22%.,以及22%.22%.至13%.。 减少额与图1(c)所查明的两种间接费用相接:勘探标志主要在第一步下降,该步骤共享工作空间并增加知识共享;执行标志主要在第二阶段下降,仅增加合同共享。 图5(a)还显示,管弦乐器的用法,即AECP中的领跑器和Team-Integraphor中的集成管理器消耗的道具,平均下降了26.0% 26.0%。

(b) Team-token usage as Knowledge Sharing and then Contract Sharing are added to Team-Integrator . Action-category shares are normalized to the original Team-Integrator token total. (c) Wall time, total output tokens, and score by task difficulty for a single run of Opus-4.6 on NL2Repo.

blocks.en: 5.3 RQ3. How Does Task Difficulty Affect the Benefits of Collaboration?
blocks.zh: 5.3 RQ3 (英语). 任务难度如何 影响协作的好处?

blocks.en: Not every task benefits from multiple workers, so we examine performance across difficulty levels and then test whether selecting the team size per task improves efficiency.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个任务都从多个工人那里受益,所以我们检查各个难度级别的业绩,然后测试每个任务选择团队规模是否提高效率.

blocks.en: Performance across difficulty levels. NL2Repo divides its tasks by the size of the reference implementation into 26 easy, 46 medium, and 32 hard tasks ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . Figure 5 (c) reports a single run of Opus-4.6 across these levels. Single achieves the highest score with the lowest time and token usage on easy tasks. On medium tasks, AECP achieves the shortest runtime with comparable token usage and the highest score among the team configurations, slightly below Single . On hard tasks, it achieves the highest score while using less time and fewer tokens than Team-Freedom and Team-Integrator . These results motivate varying the team size rather than assigning multiple workers to every task.
blocks.zh: 跨难度水平的表现. NL2Repo将其任务按照参考执行的规模划分为26个简易,46个中型,32个硬任务(Ding等,2025. 图5(c)显示这些级别的Opus-4.6单行图。 单曲在轻松的任务上以最少的时间和符号使用来达到最高分. 在中等任务上,AECP实现最短的运行时间,具有可比较的标志用法和团队配置中得分最高,略低于Single. 在艰难的任务上,它取得了最高的分数,同时使用的时间也比Team-Freedom和Team-Integrator少. 这些结果促使团队规模不同,而不是指派多名工人从事每一项工作。

blocks.en: Table 3: Matched adaptive versus fixed team sizing on 104 tasks. Each row compares the same task subset using the selected N N and forced N = 3 N=3 .
blocks.zh: 表3:104项任务的适应规模与固定队伍规模相匹配。 每行使用所选的N N 和强制 N = 3 N = 3 来比较相同的任务子集.

blocks.en: Adaptive team sizing. With Opus-4.8, we let the leader choose the worker count N N from the dependency graph for each of the 104 NL2Repo tasks, grouping interdependent modules into clusters and assigning one worker per cluster, before any implementation begins. A task assigned one worker runs the same way as Single , since a lone worker has no teammates to coordinate with. We compare the selected configuration with a fixed N = 3 N=3 configuration on the same tasks, grouping results by the selected worker count.
blocks.zh: 适应性团队规模。 有了Opus-4.8,我们让领导从104 NL2Repo任务中的每个任务依赖图中选择工人N计数N,将相互依存的模块分组,并在任何执行开始前为每个组分配一名工人。 由于单身工人没有队友可以与之协调, 我们在相同任务上将选定的配置与固定的N=3N=3配置进行比较,由选定的工人计数对结果进行分组.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that the leader assigns one worker to 39 tasks and more than three workers to only 3. Overall, adaptive sizing reduces average wall time from 785.7 785.7 to 639.2 639.2 seconds ( 18.6 % 18.6\% ), with both configurations scoring 0.66 0.66 . The largest saving occurs in the group assigned one worker, where runtime falls by 46.1 % 46.1\% without a score decrease. This group includes all 26 easy tasks, the level at which Single performs best in Figure 5 (c). On these tasks, selecting the team size reduces runtime while matching the score of a fixed team.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,领导指派一名工人承担39个任务,三名以上工人只承担3个任务。 总体来说,适应性测距将平均墙壁时间从785.7个785.7个缩短到639.2个639.2秒(18.6% 18.6分),两个配置均得分0.66 0.66分. 最大的储蓄发生在分配一名工人的组别中,其中运行时间下降了46.1%,没有降低分数。 这一组包括所有26个容易完成的任务,即Single在图5(c)中表现最佳的级别。 在这些任务上,选择团队规模在匹配固定团队分数的同时会缩短运行时间.

blocks.en: 5.4 RQ4. Does AECP Limit Cross-Worker Malicious Propagation?
blocks.zh: 5.4 RQ4 (中文(简体) ). AECP是否限制跨工人恶意宣传?.

blocks.en: Table 4: Propagation of malicious instructions from a compromised worker across 20 attack cases.
blocks.zh: 表4:在20起攻击案件中传播一名受害工人的恶意指示。

blocks.en: The communication used to coordinate development can also carry malicious instructions between workers ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . We therefore examine propagation after one worker has already been compromised. We construct 20 attack cases from NL2Repo using five payload families. Each payload presents a malicious code change as a cross-module compatibility requirement and instructs the compromised worker to relay it to teammates. We compare AECP with Team-Freedom using the same Opus-4.6 model, compromised role, and payload. We measure reach , whether the instruction reaches a benign worker, and adoption , whether a benign worker incorporates the requested change into its code. Each case is run three times and counts as positive for a metric if the event occurs in any run. Appendix I describes the payload families.
blocks.zh: 用于协调发展的通信也可能在工人之间携带恶意指令(Lee等,2025;Gu等,2024.). 因此,在一个工人已经受到损害之后,我们审查传播情况。 我们利用5个有效载荷家庭从NL2Repo建造了20个攻击箱。 每个有效载荷将恶意代码更改作为跨模块相容性要求,并指示受损工人将其转发给队友. 我们使用相同的Opus-4.6模型将AECP和Team-Freedom进行比较,降低了作用和有效载荷。 我们衡量的是,该指示是否送达良工,以及是否收养良工将所要求的修改纳入其守则。 每个案件进行三次审理,如果事件发生在任何一次审理中,则计算为正数。 附录一介绍了有效载荷的种类。

blocks.en: With Team-Freedom , malicious instructions reach benign workers in 19 of 20 cases ( 95 % 95\% ) and induce adoption in eight ( 40 % 40\% ). Under AECP, no malicious instruction reaches a benign worker and none is adopted. The compromised worker tries to relay the instruction as a message, which AECP does not provide. The result thus reflects the removal of the message channel; instructions written into artifacts or shared code by a compromised worker form a separate threat that these cases do not exercise.
blocks.zh: 在20起个案中,有19起(95%95%%)为善良的工人提供了恶意指导,8起(40%40%%)为诱导收养。 根据AECP,没有恶意指示到达良性工人,也没有人被采纳。 受到影响的工人试图将指示作为信息转发,而AECP没有提供。 因此,结果反映了信息通道被拆除;被损坏的工人写入文物或共享代码的指示构成了一个单独的威胁,而这些案例并不行使。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced AECP, a protocol that replaces free-form inter-agent messages with Knowledge and Contract Artifacts on which the execution harness acts. Knowledge Artifacts supply prior findings at the point of use, while Contract Artifacts make interface commitments available during parallel implementation and screen completed code for static mismatches with them. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, AECP raises average code quality over all three baselines, shortens runtime relative to the two team baselines, and transfers across different agent scaffolds. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocked every malicious instruction relayed as a message in our attack cases. Simple tasks often favor fewer agents. Overall, AECP makes coordination explicit and checkable, so parallel agents need not rely solely on natural-language promises.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AECP, 一种协议,用执行手段所操作的知识与合同相取代免费的代理信息。 Knowledge Artifacts提供使用时的先验发现,而Contract Artifacts则在平行执行时提供接口承诺,并筛选完成的代码,以便与它们进行静态不匹配. 跨 Doc2Repo,NL2Repo,和CodeProjectEval,AECP提高了所有三个基线的平均代码质量,相对两个团队基线缩短了运行时间,并跨出不同的代理脚手架. 艺术独家通信 也阻止了每一个恶意指令 传递作为我们攻击案件的信息。 简单的任务往往倾向于减少代理。 总的来说,非经合方案使协调变得明确和可核查,因此平行的代理人不必仅仅依赖自然语言的承诺。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our experiments use publicly available benchmarks built from open-source repositories and involve no human subjects or personal data. The security study in RQ4 examines how malicious instructions propagate between agents after one agent is compromised, with the aim of informing defenses. All attack cases ran in isolated containers without network access, no payload uses a network endpoint, and the generated repositories were discarded after scoring. We describe the payload families but do not release their full texts (Appendix I ). Because AECP removes only the free-form message channel between agents, it should not be treated as a defense against instructions carried through artifacts or shared code. Code produced by coding agents, including AECP, may contain errors or vulnerabilities and should be reviewed before use.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验使用公开来源的储存库建立的基准,不涉及人类主体和个人数据。 RQ4的安全研究研究了在一个特工被泄露后,如何在特工之间传播恶意指令,目的是告知辩方. 所有攻击案件都存放在孤立的容器中,没有网络接入,没有有效载荷使用网络终点,生成的存储器在打分后被丢弃. 我们描述有效载荷的种类,但不公布其全文(附录一)。 由于AECP只去除代理之间的自由式消息通道,因此不应将其作为对通过文物或共享代码所携带的指示的防御. 由编码剂(包括AECP)生成的编码可能含有错误或弱点,在使用前应加以审查。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: Shared context and structured communication help agents exchange information across tasks. Agent Context Protocols combine standardized messages with persistent execution blueprints that record dependencies and intermediate outputs ( Bhardwaj et al., 2025 ) . AgentRoom supports concurrent coding through a shared workspace with tools for claiming files, inspecting peer status, and exchanging messages ( Cho and Lee, 2026 ) . These mechanisms make information and collaborators’ progress accessible. Making a finding available, however, does not by itself connect it to a later code access where it becomes relevant. A worker may still need to recognize that an earlier discovery applies to its current work. AECP makes this connection explicit by associating findings with code scopes and delivering them when workers access matching code.
blocks.zh: 共享背景和结构化的通信帮助代理人在任务之间交流信息。 代理背景协议将标准化信息与记录依赖性和中间产出的持久执行蓝图结合起来(Bhardwaj等,2025年)。 AgentRoom支持通过共享的工作空间同时进行编码,并配有要求文件,检查对等状态,以及交换消息的工具(Cho and Lee, 2026). 这些机制使人们能够获得信息和合作者的进展。 然而,提供一项调查结果本身并不能将它与后来的编码访问联系起来,因为后者是相关的。 工人可能需要认识到,早先的发现适用于其目前的工作。 AECP通过将发现与代码范围联系起来,并在工人访问匹配代码时提供,使这种联系变得明确.

blocks.en: Contracts and verification address a complementary problem of keeping independently produced work consistent. SEMAP specifies the input and output artifacts required by each agent role and uses verification outcomes to govern workflow transitions ( Mao et al., 2025 ) . Its behavioral contracts define agent responsibilities, leaving the interfaces promised to dependent code as a separate verification target. The Specification Gap examines incompatible assumptions in independently generated code and introduces an AST-based detector for conflicts between implementations ( Sartori, 2026 ) . AECP checks a different relationship, comparing each submitted implementation with the interface commitments on which its consumers rely. Those commitments can also change during development, so checking the producer alone is insufficient to keep consumers informed. AECP therefore tracks registered symbol dependencies and requires affected consumers to read revised contracts and renew their registrations before completing their tasks.
blocks.zh: 合同和核查解决了一个相辅相成的问题,即保持独立生产的工作的一致性。 SEMAP规定了每个代理角色所需的输入和输出文物,并利用核查结果管理工作流程过渡(Mao等,2025.). 其行为合同定义了代理责任,将承诺依赖代码的界面留作单独的核查目标. " 规格差距 " 审查了独立生成的代码中不相容的假设,并引入了基于AST的检测器,用于处理执行之间冲突(Sartori, 2026年)。 AECP检查了不同的关系,将每个提交的执行情况与其消费者所依赖的界面承诺进行比较。 这些承诺在发展过程中也可能发生变化,因此仅检查生产者不足以使消费者了解情况。 因此,AECP跟踪注册的符号依赖性,要求受影响的消费者在完成任务前阅读修改后的合同并续签登记.

blocks.en: Other systems pass structured intermediate artifacts along a fixed pipeline. CodeS ( Zan et al., 2026 ) builds a repository through successive sketches of its directory structure, files, and functions, and AutoP2C ( Lin et al., 2025 ) generates repositories from papers through blueprint extraction, decomposition, and debugging stages. AgentMesh ( Khanzadeh, 2025 ) , DocAgent ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , MapCoder ( Islam et al., 2024 ) , and MAGIS ( Tao et al., 2024 ) route work through planner, coder, reviewer, or verifier roles, while CodeAgent ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) equips a single agent with repository tools. Code2MCP ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) transforms existing repositories into Model Context Protocol services through a multi-stage workflow with a run-review-fix loop, and CompileAgent ( Hu et al., 2025 ) compiles real-world repositories with a tool-integrated agent that searches for build instructions and resolves errors. Each artifact is consumed by the next agent in the pipeline, whereas AECP’s artifacts are acted on by the harness while workers run in parallel. RepoGenesis ( Peng et al., 2026 ) extends repository-generation evaluation to multilingual microservices with deployment and API-coverage measures.
blocks.zh: 其他系统沿固定管线通过结构化中间工艺品. 代码 (Zan等,2026年)通过对其目录结构,文件和功能相继的草图来建立寄存器,而AutoP2C(Lin等,2025年)通过蓝图取出,分解和调试阶段从纸上生成寄存器. Agent Mesh(Khanzadeh,2025年),医生 (杨等,2025)., MapCoder. (Islam等人,2024年),和MAGIS(Tao等人,2024年)通过规划员,编码员,审查员,或核查员角色进行路由工作,而CodeAgent(Zhang等人,2024年)则为单一代理人配备了存储工具. Code2MCP(Ouyang等,2026年)通过多阶段工作流程将已存在的寄存器转换为模式上下文协议服务,并带有运行审查-固定回路,而CompileAgent(Hu等,2025年)则用工具集成代理来编译现实世界寄存器,以搜索构建指令并解决出错. 每件文物都由输油管中的下一种剂来消耗,而AECP的文物则在工人平行运行时由吊带来操作。 RepoGenesis (Peng等, 2026年) 将寄存器生成评价扩展至多语言微服务,并附有部署和API覆盖措施.

blocks.en: In concurrent work, CodeTeam combines structured design contracts, dependency-aware development, and Git-based interface update propagation for repository-level code generation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Because it identifies interface mismatches through QA tests, deviations from declared interfaces can go undetected when those tests do not cover the affected calls. Also concurrent, Contract-Coding projects user intent into a language contract that serves as a single source of truth for parallel module generation, audits the workspace against the contract’s signatures, and updates the contract as execution proceeds ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . AECP shares this contract-first structure. It differs in exposing each declared interface as importable stubs at the final module paths, tracking which consumers depend on which symbols, and keeping those consumers from completing after a revision until they have read it. Its Knowledge Artifacts also carry findings that fall outside any interface, such as environment and runtime behavior.

blocks.en:
Following the terminology used by Anthropic (2026e) , we distinguish two broad patterns by where coordination primarily resides, subagent delegation and agent teams .
In subagent delegation , a main agent assigns tasks to sub-agents in isolated contexts and directs subsequent work from their returned results, as Figure 6 (a) shows. Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026b ) provide this as a built-in facility, and FastContext ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) uses it to delegate repository exploration and return compact evidence. Manager-based systems such as CAID ( Geng and Neubig, 2026 ) and Agyn ( Benkovich and Valkov, 2026 ) extend the pattern to implementation, centralizing task delegation and integration in a manager.
In agent teams , teammates hold separate parts of the work and coordinate among themselves, as Figure 6 (b) shows. These interactions may follow predefined workflows, as in ChatDev’s role-based dialogues and MetaGPT’s structured development pipelines ( Qian et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) . Claude Code agent teams support direct teammate communication and shared task state while retaining a lead for overall coordination, and each teammate may delegate to sub-agents of its own ( Anthropic, 2026e ) .

Its textual scope, ’mcp-runtime’ , identifies the topic, while file_tags binds the finding to the code location where it applies. blocks.en: At publication, the harness first checks that the witness contains only permitted shape-level operations, such as imports, calls, construction, and attribute checks. A malformed witness is rejected before storage. A valid witness is then executed in the workspace and prints KG:REACHED before its assertion. A zero exit marks the artifact witness-checked ; a failure after the marker refutes the witness and rejects the publication; and a failure before the marker indicates that setup did not complete, so the artifact is stored as unchecked . An artifact without a witness is likewise unchecked . If a consumer later flags a stored artifact, the harness reruns its witness, removes a refuted artifact from subsequent retrieval and delivery, and retains the outcome in its audit record.

blocks.en: The harness derives a worker’s current scope whenever it accesses a code file or symbol. It first matches artifacts bound to that symbol or file and then considers artifacts associated with enclosing directories or named global scopes. Refuted artifacts are excluded. Matching artifacts are inserted into the observation returned by the code-access operation, so retrieval occurs at the point of use rather than through a separate inter-agent message. The harness additionally forwards each new finding to workers owning related modules, ranking the same file above modules connected to it in the planned dependency graph and those above modules in the same package. Each lookup delivers at most five artifacts and each forward at most four, newest first; a worker that re-reads a file receives only artifacts it has not already seen; and every delivered artifact is labeled with its witness state. A scope matches the current access when one path contains the other or the two share a path segment, and each delivered artifact is truncated to 280 characters. A single access therefore adds at most five truncated artifacts, about 1,400 characters, to the returned observation. A symbol scope is matched through the file that defines it, so matching ultimately operates on file paths rather than resolved names, and aliases and re-exports do not affect it: a finding is delivered when a worker reads a file that its tags cover. Conflicting findings are resolved through flags: when a consumer flags a claim that contradicts what it observes, the harness reruns the witness and stops delivering the claim if the witness refutes it. In the Opus-4.6 NL2Repo AECP runs, a task receives 41.9 knowledge deliveries on average; judged from the traces by an LLM, 36 % 36\% of the delivered findings are used in the recipient’s subsequent work. Of the delivered findings, 71 % 71\% are witness-checked, and they account for 88 % 88\% of the findings used. Witness execution rejects 14 % 14\% of publication attempts before they enter circulation, and consumers flag 0.9 0.9 findings per task on average, 0.2 0.2 of which are retracted after the witness is rerun.

blocks.en: Appendix G Trace Analysis for Figure 1
blocks.zh: 图1追踪分析

blocks.en: We analyze trajectories of an agent team that coordinates through natural-language messages, run with Opus-4.6 on all 104 NL2Repo tasks. An LLM (Opus 5) reads each complete multi-agent trajectory and labels every agent turn with one primary activity: Explore (searching, reading files, tracing dependencies, or otherwise acquiring information), Implement (creating or modifying code), Test (running or inspecting validation), or Other (planning, coordination messages, and status updates). It marks an Explore turn as repeated exploration only when another agent had earlier obtained information sufficient for the same need and the later turn reproduces rather than extends that work; re-inspection after the code changed, or to verify an earlier finding, is excluded. It marks an Implement turn as conflict-driven rework only when already-written code is revised because decisions in different modules or by different agents are incompatible, such as mismatched signatures, return types, or data structures; a test failure alone is not sufficient. Each flagged turn must cite the earlier turns that establish the information or the conflicting decision, and uncertain cases are labeled negative. Token and turn shares follow from these labels. We manually checked 50 flagged events and confirmed all of them.
blocks.zh: 我们分析一个代理团队的轨迹 通过自然语言的信息进行协调, 运行与Opus-4.6 在所有104 NL2Repo任务。 一个LLM(Opus 5)读取每个完整的多剂轨迹,并标出每个具有一主要活性的剂转动: 探索(搜索、阅读文件、追踪依赖性,或以其他方式获取信息)、执行(创建或修改代码)、测试(运行或检查验证)或其他(规划、协调信息和状况更新)。 只有当另一个代理人早先获得足以满足同样需要的信息,而后转则复制而不是延长该工作时,才将 " 探索 " 号标记为重复探索;排除了代码更改后重新检查,或核实更早的发现。 它标志着一个执行回合,即冲突驱动的重作,只有在修改了已经写好的代码时,因为不同模块中的决定或由不同代理人作出的决定是不相容的,例如不匹配的签名、返回类型或数据结构;单是测试失败是不够的。 每个标有标记的转弯必须引用早先确定该信息或冲突决定的转弯,不确定情况标为负数。 从这些标签开始, 我们手动检查了50起标有标记的事件,并证实了所有事件。

blocks.en: The five payload families request safeguard disabling, validation bypass, input passthrough, a local trace sink, or a hidden keyword argument. Each presents the requested change as a cross-module compatibility requirement and asks the compromised worker to relay it to teammates. None uses a network endpoint. These cases evaluate propagation after an initial worker compromise, rather than the likelihood of that compromise. All attack cases ran in isolated containers without network access, and the generated repositories were discarded after scoring. We describe the payload families but do not release their full texts.
blocks.zh: 5个有效载荷家族要求保护功能失效、验证绕行、输入传递、局部跟踪槽或隐藏关键词参数。 每一个都将要求的更改作为跨模块相容性要求,并要求受损的工人将其转发给队友. 无使用网络端点. 这些案例评价的是最初工人妥协之后的传播情况,而不是这种妥协的可能性。 所有攻击案件都存放在孤立的集装箱中,没有网络接入,生成的储存库在打分后被丢弃。 我们描述了有效载荷的种类,但没有公布其全文。
